roadmap_90_days.target_outcome: Evidence-ready beginner profile for the next Data Scientist learning, internship, or project opportunity.

phases.focus: Build foundations in Python, SQL, Statistics.

tasks.title: Learn Python fundamentals
tasks.objective: Close the highest-priority gap for Data Scientist.
actions: Study the core concepts and terminology of Python.
Complete at least three hands-on exercises using Python.
Record mistakes, corrections, and evidence of progress in a learning log.
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed fundamentals notebook or mini-demo proving basic Python ability.

tasks.title: Connect new learning to existing strengths
tasks.objective: Reuse evidence from Campus Placement Insights Dashboard instead of starting from zero.
actions: List the current skills and project evidence that transfer to this career.
Add one small feature that combines an existing strength with Python.
tasks.deliverable: A one-page skill map linking existing evidence to the target career.

phases.success_check: Explain the basics of Python and show one working artifact without unsupported claims.

phases.focus: Apply Python, SQL, Statistics in one evidence-based project.

tasks.title: Build a Data Scientist portfolio project
tasks.objective: Convert learning into demonstrable portfolio evidence.
actions: Build evidence for the core skills: Python, SQL, Statistics, Machine Learning
Include at least one measurable use of Python.
Add input validation, failure handling, and a short test checklist.
tasks.deliverable: A working project repository with README, screenshots or output, and test evidence.

tasks.title: Evaluate the project against career requirements
tasks.objective: Check whether the project proves the required skills rather than only mentioning them.
actions: Map each required career skill to a concrete project file, feature, or result.
Identify one remaining weak skill and improve the project to address it.
tasks.deliverable: A requirement-to-evidence checklist with no invented experience.

phases.success_check: A reviewer can run or inspect the project and find evidence for the mapped skills.

phases.focus: Package evidence, validate readiness, and prepare the next application or education step.

tasks.title: Create the final portfolio case study
tasks.objective: Explain the problem, decisions, implementation, evidence, limitations, and outcome.
actions: Write a concise case study using the completed project.
Add a skills section that links every claim to evidence.
Document limitations, risks, and the next technical improvement.
tasks.deliverable: A publishable portfolio case study and updated resume/project section.

tasks.title: Run a readiness review
tasks.objective: Test readiness for the next Data Scientist opportunity.
actions: Repeat the career match using the updated profile evidence.
Practice explaining the project and three technical decisions.
Choose one verified next step from the career dataset or backend-provided resources.
tasks.deliverable: A final readiness score, remaining-gap list, and next 30-day action decision.

phases.success_check: The profile contains a tested project, an evidence-backed case study, and an updated remaining-gap list.
